title: Install VS Code or Cursor
summary: Get a code editor on your machine.

steps.instruction: Pick one editor. VS Code is the common classroom default. Cursor is VS Code with an AI sidebar. Either one works for this program.
steps.expectedResult: You know which installer you are about to download.

steps.instruction: Download the installer from the official site: https://code.visualstudio.com or https://cursor.com. Run it and accept the defaults.
steps.expectedResult: The app appears in your Start menu or Applications folder.

steps.instruction: Open the editor. Use File → Open Folder and choose an empty folder such as C:\LEARN-SD.
steps.expectedResult: The sidebar shows your folder name. You are looking at files, not a welcome maze.

steps.instruction: Install the recommended language extras later as each course needs them. For now, you only need the editor itself.
steps.expectedResult: You can create a new file, type text, and save it.
